deviations: Coalition/opposition dummies use prior_coalition / prior_opposition (governing status in the period up to the survey), which the dataset codebook flags as the analysis variables; govern_together / opposition_together (flagged 'not used') were not used.
Women/men partisan DV built as 10 - dislike from the gender-disaggregated file (it stores only the reversed 0=like scale), so coefficients are on the 0-10 liking scale like columns 1-2.
Seat counts of 999 treated as missing; the four-MP restriction requires to_prior_seats >= 4 and from_prior_seats >= 4.

Country-year fixed effects and clustering both on cntryyr (no country-year in the estimation sample holds two election dates). The table's 'Country and year fixed effects' label was read as country-year FE, following the text.
Left-right distance uses the dataset's precomputed standardized rile_distance_s (raw rile_distance mean 22.44 over the full file).
notes: One exploratory run (attempt-1, no RESULT lines) checked the variables, then one estimation run (final). OLS via fixest::feols on directed dyads with both parties >= 4 MPs (prior seats), country-year FE, SEs clustered by election (cntryyr). n_directed_dyads is the column-2 N (the same as column 1: 1525); n_election_studies is the number of distinct country-years in that sample (76; 19 countries remain after the restrictions). No specification was tuned toward any paper value.
